text:
olivia: Quick sync before we flip the AB experiment. Need to finalize the credit matrix and thresholds (auto-credit vs finance review) and how partner invoices are handled.

ben: Proposed credit matrix:
- auto-credit if estimated_credit < $150 AND not partner-billed
- finance-review if estimated_credit >= $150 or tax_country in ['DE','FR','IT']
- partner-billed always handoff to partner-ops + optional platform promo <= $50

tara: Sounds reasonable. For prorates use days_remaining/period_days * price_delta. Auto-credit should post as credit memo referencing original invoice.

olivia: Agreed. Add rule: if invoice paid within 14d and estimated_credit < $50 then refund automatically instead of credit memo to reduce confusion.

ben: SQL I'll run to produce cohort and compute days:```sql
select s.customer_id, s.id as subscription_id, i.invoice_id, i.issue_date,
date_part('day', s.billing_cycle_end - now()) as days_left
from subscriptions s
join invoices i on i.subscription_id = s.id
where s.status='active' and s.created_at < '2026-06-01';
```

tara: Need tax_country and partner_id columns. Also include `estimated_credit_usd` and `auto_credit_flag`.

ben: Quick python snippet to estimate credit:```py
est = days_left/period_days * (old_monthly - new_monthly)
```

olivia: Ledger treatment: credit memo reduces AR and posts contra-revenue GL 4205. Finance wants CSV: invoice_id, credit_memo_id, amount_usd, gl_codes.

tara: Partner flow: tag `partner_passthrough=true` and include partner_contact and partner_account_id. Partner-ops will confirm refund responsibility; meanwhile we issue platform promo up to $50 if customer requests.

ben: Also add `grandfather_reason` column (e.g., 'pre-T0 subscription') so support can explain.

accounts-bot: Reminder: export job scheduled for 03:00 UTC. Will post to https://internal.redwood/exports/2045123456-credit-matrix-export.csv and notify #eng-billing.

olivia: Action items: Ben run cohort and attach estimated exposure (sum est). Tara add tax columns and partner fields. I'll draft customer-facing help center blurb and short email template. Lock policy at 16:00 PT if no objections.

tara: On it. Expect ~950 rows in the canary.

ben: Running now.

accounts-bot: Job started at 03:02 UTC - 948 accounts tagged with `experiment_ab=canary`. Export uploaded.
